intro: Are you a small business owner or entrepreneur looking for financial assistance to grow your business? 🤔 The PM Mudra Loan Yojana is a government-backed scheme that provides loans to non-corporate, non-farm sector income-generating activities 🤑. In this article, we will guide you through the process of applying for a PM Mudra Loan online in 2026 📈.

sections.heading: 📈 Introduction to PM Mudra Loan Yojana
sections.content: The PM Mudra Loan Yojana was launched in 2015 by the Government of India to promote entrepreneurship and job creation in the country 🌟. The scheme provides loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm sector income-generating activities, such as small businesses, artisans, and self-employed individuals 🤑. The loan is provided by public sector banks, private sector banks, regional rural banks, and microfinance institutions 🏦.

sections.heading: 📝 Eligibility Criteria for PM Mudra Loan
sections.content: To be eligible for a PM Mudra Loan, you must meet the following criteria: ✅ You must be a citizen of India 🇮🇳. ✅ You must be above 18 years of age 🎂. ✅ You must have a business plan or proposal for a non-farm sector income-generating activity 📊. ✅ You must not have any pending loans or credit facilities with other banks or financial institutions 🚫.

sections.heading: 📁 Required Documents for PM Mudra Loan
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan, you will need to provide the following documents: 📝 Identity proof (Aadhaar card, PAN card, etc.) 📝 Address proof (passport, driving license, etc.) 📝 Business plan or proposal 📝 Income tax returns (if applicable) 📝 Bank statement (if applicable) 📝 Other documents as required by the lender 📝.

sections.heading: 📊 How to Apply for PM Mudra Loan Online in 2026
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan online in 2026, follow these steps: 📈 Step 1: Visit the official website of the lender (e.g., SBI, HDFC Bank, etc.) 📈 Step 2: Click on the 'PM Mudra Loan' or 'Mudra Loan' option 📈 Step 3: Fill in the online application form with your personal and business details 📝 Step 4: Upload the required documents 📁 Step 5: Submit the application form and wait for the lender to process your loan application 🕒.

faqs.q: What is the interest rate for PM Mudra Loan?
faqs.a: The interest rate for PM Mudra Loan varies from lender to lender, but it is generally in the range of 8.5% to 12.5% per annum 📊.

faqs.q: What is the repayment tenure for PM Mudra Loan?
faqs.a: The repayment tenure for PM Mudra Loan is up to 5 years, depending on the lender and the loan amount 📆.
